WALLET_SECRET_SALT.description: Optional salt value used in conjunction with the wallet secret key for secure key derivation or encryption.

WALLET_SECRET_KEY.description: Private secret key for the wallet that the plugin will use to sign transactions.

WALLET_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Public key for the wallet associated with WALLET_SECRET_KEY, used as the sender address for transactions.

SOL_ADDRESS.description: Solana address that the plugin will operate on or reference for token operations.

SLIPPAGE.description: Maximum allowed slippage percentage for swap or trading operations.

SOLANA_RPC_URL.description: URL of the Solana RPC endpoint the plugin will connect to for blockchain interactions.

HELIUS_API_KEY.description: API key for accessing the Helius enhanced RPC or analytics services.

BIRDEYE_API_KEY.description: API key for accessing Birdeye price feeds and analytics.

SOLANA_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Alternative setting name that can supply the wallet's public key before falling back to WALLET_PUBLIC_KEY.

SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Base58 or base64 encoded private key for the Solana wallet, used when a full keypair is required.

WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Alternative environment variable for the Solana wallet private key, checked if SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY is not set.
